command.reason: AI-assisted platform technical review of Any Quote LP 0.3.0 under owner authorization, not an external audit. The exact source, compiler, constructor mappings, deployed native Host/Hook/Ledger and manifest match. Protected run 34617665297 attempt 1 passed all 16 cases, 28 operations and eight native checks for each positive case. All ten required areas were reviewed, including fixed configuration limits, authority, permanent LP lock, atomic rollback and backed direct native ETH claims. Approval is for the standalone native Any Quote profile; no additional eligible families or arbitrary composition is granted. Compatible ERC20 behavior and a usable immutable conversion route remain prerequisites. The 30 bps fee is assessed on gross quote and actual conversion proceeds are credited in ETH; route costs and external liquidity remain dependencies. Onchain admission, real canary trades/claims, finality and index evidence remain separate. Public availability stays on hold until the owner explicitly releases it.

catalogDefinition.detail: Creates one billion tokens with permanently locked initial liquidity and a target starting value of about $5,000. The fixed platform fee is 0.3%; separate creator buy and sell fees can be set from 0% to 10% in 1% steps. Fees are converted and credited in native ETH on each trade. Pair tokens require a usable market price and compatible route.
